fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our 2014 fuel consumption, a hypothetical ten percent increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased fuel expense by approximately $38.7 million for the year ended December 31, 2014.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company states 'have not hedged fuel price risk in recent years'. Note: also has a foreign currency swap for aircraft lease revenue, unrelated to fuel hedging.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel expense for 2014 increased $2.7 million, or 0.7 percent, compared with 2013. We consumed 7.0 percent more system fuel gallons, which was offset by a 5.9 percent decrease in the average cost per gallon. [Derived: 120.5M × 1.070 = 128.9M gallons]
